title: SAIB: Buriza.Mobile - A Secure, On-the-Go Mobile Cardano Wallet

ms.promise:
Design the user interface and user experience for Buriza.Mobile, ensuring a seamless, intuitive workflow tailored for mobile devices using both Android and iOS operating systems. 
The design will focus on enabling easy access to core functionalities such as transaction management, dApp integration, and viewing balances and assets. Additionally, it will easily adapt and support decentralized operations such as providing the option to have a full-node setup for users to have a more decentralized experience. The design will be optimized for mobile, ensuring smooth navigation and efficient use of screen space. 
1. A design file with wireframes and mockups for all key mobile screens 
・Sending assets: Form for entering recipient address, asset type, and amount 
・Receiving assets: Any received assets will reflect and display in the wallet balance and asset list once the transaction is confirmed on the blockchain 
・Viewing balance and assets: Shows an overview of the wallet's current balance, list of assets held, and their respective values 
・Transaction history: List of past transactions, filtered or sorted by date, asset type, or transaction status for the specific wallet address 
・Full

ms.promise:
Develop the Buriza.Mobile interface and functionality as per the UI/UX design for both Android and iOS. This includes building the mobile front-end for wallet interactions, such as transaction management, asset displays, and integration with decentralized applications (dApps). 
We will provide support for self-installation and self-verification, enabling users to have the capability of independently installing the app. This includes the ability to pull the source code from a Git repository, compile it themselves, and deploy it directly onto their devices, ensuring maximum trust, transparency, and control over the application's functionality.
1. Source code for mobile front-end UI components and interaction flows.
